pattern.en: She has a meeting at three.

text.ru: «У меня есть» = I have (he / she / it has). Вопросы и отрицания — через do: Do you have…? I don't have… В британской речи часто have got: I've got, Have you got…?, I haven't got. have также в устойчивых выражениях: have breakfast, have a shower, have a good time — там только do.
text.en: “I have” = I have (he has). Questions and negatives use do: Do you have…? British speech often uses have got: I've got, Have you got…? have also appears in fixed phrases: have breakfast, have a shower — always with do.
text.es: have / has = tener. Preguntas y negación con do. have got (británico).
